# bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_properties (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Threat Class Property ETL Filters.

The Threat Class Property ETL Filter object filters Cloud Data Connector (CDC) flow data by threat class or property.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC ETL Threat Class Property Filters filtered by an attribute
data "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_properties" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_property"
  }
}

# Get CDC ETL Threat Class Property Filters filtered by tag
data "bloxone_cdc_etl_filter_threat_class_properties" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) The list of Threat Class Property ETL Filters matching the specified filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `data` (List of String) The list of threat classes or threat properties to filter on. Available threat classes: `APT`, `Bot`, `CompromisedDomain`, `CompromisedHost`, `Cryptocurrency`, `DNSTunnel`, `ExploitKit`, `ICS`, `IllegalContent`, `InternetInfrastructure`, `IntrusionAttempt`, `LimitedDistro`, `MaliciousNameserver`, `MalwareC2`, `MalwareC2DGA`, `MalwareDownload`, `Parked`, `Phishing`, `Policy`, `Proxy`, `Scam`, `Scanner`, `Sinkhole`, `Spambot`, `Suspicious`, `UncategorizedThreat`, `UnwantedContent`, `WebAppAttack`. Threat properties belong to a threat class (for example `MalwareC2_Generic`).
- `name` (String) The name of the Threat Class Property ETL filter.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the Threat Class Property ETL filter.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the Threat Class Property ETL filter is enabled. Defaults to `false`.
- `filter_source` (String) The source the Threat Class Property ETL filter applies to. Allowed values:
  * _SOURCE_DEFAULT_
  * _SOURCE_INGRESS_

Defaults to _SOURCE_DEFAULT_.
- `ingress_policy_action` (String) The ingress policy action of the Threat Class Property ETL filter.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the Threat Class Property ETL filter.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `tags_all` (Map of String) The tags for the Threat Class Property ETL filter, including default tags.
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.
